__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
It has a large central eye that blinks like a guppy and eyestalks atop the
round body which can charm you with its cuteness.  Baby beholders are known for
their playful personality.  Hmmm....  It looks like the baby is teething!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: You meet a baby beholder's cute gaze!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle baby beholder

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This is a creature with the upper torso of a beautiful woman, but the lower
body of a four-legged beast.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A pet lamia stands here waiting for her next command.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle lamia pet

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He smiles at you, almost as if he knows you.  He is so friendly, you have no
choice but to reciprocate.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A citizen of Thalos is here, conversing with everyone.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle citizen man

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is dressed in plate, and he looks quite formidable.  At the moment, though,
he is just giggling with a kid running about.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An imperial cityguard is here, keeping the peace of Thalos.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle guard imperial cityguard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She is beautiful, dressed in a sundress that sparkles with gems sown in.  She
smiles at you, and your heart flutters at the thought that you have her
attention, if only for a moment.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A female citizen of Thalos is here, showing off her new dress.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle citizen woman female

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Gordon is dressed in full mithril plate, and he looks indestructible.  He eyes
you suspiciously not only because you are a stranger, but because you are an
ARMED stranger.  Better not do any funny stuff in his presence.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr:
Gordon the Brave, the Defender of Thalos, is here, looking at no
one but you, the only stranger in town.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle gordon defender

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The priest must have lost his mind.  He keeps saying that one day, evil will
prevail and take over Thalos and bring the whole city down.  Obviously, no one
listens to this fool.  The priest's right fist is covered in golden silk,
and he clenches it at you.  Other than that, he is dressed all in black.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A fanatic priest is here, foretelling the destruction of Thalos.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle priest

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He stands here gloriously telling of Thalos's history, how it is now referred by
the world as 'The City of Peace'.  He is very happy to be the high priest here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The priest of Thalos tells you of the glories of this city.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle priest

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
It is a big chunk of rock that has been magically formed into a giant
stone creature.  It stands here guarding the city.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: In the corner you see a large, stone golem faithfully standing watch.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle golem stone

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He looks very busy, but he takes the time to say, 'Hi!  Welcome to Thalos!'
He looks very proud of his work.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The mayor of Thalos is sitting here, doing his paperwork.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle mayor

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks at you, and says, 'What's your poison, stranger?'
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Dan the Barkeep stands by the counter wiping a glass.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dan barkeep

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Looking down at you with blood splattered all over his face and apron,
he asks, 'How much you want?'
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: George the Butcher is here whacking away at a side of beef.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle george butcher

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: She smiles at you meekly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Farmer Betty looks at you sweetly offering you some apples.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle farmer betty

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Thaellor sweats rivers and complains about the heat as he pounds the
metal into items of defense and destruction.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Thaellor is here selling his metal wares.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle thaellor dwarf

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Ben tries to pawn his various wares to you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Ben the Smith sells metal odds and ends to anyone interested.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle ben smith

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The librarian looks busy and whispers, 'Shhh!'
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The librarian is here shelving books away neatly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle librarian

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This young scholar is studying to be a priest.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A young scholar studies quietly in the corner.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle scholar boy

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This old wizard almost looks like he is about to fall over and sleep.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An old wizard sits quietly at the counter waiting for a sale.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle wizard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She is beautiful, dressed in a sundress that sparkles with gems sown in.  She
smiles at you, and your heart flutters at the thought that you have her
attention, and you jump to her offer for a massage.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A beautiful woman is here offering you a massage.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle masseuse woman

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He smiles at you, almost as if he knows you.  He is so friendly, you have no
choice but to reciprocate and join him and the others in the soothing pool.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A man is here bathing.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bather man

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is dressed in plate, and he looks quite formidable.  At the moment,
he is looking at a map of Thalos aside his fellow co-workers keeping
track of each city patrol.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An imperial cityguard overseeing patrols in the city.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle guard imperial cityguard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is dressed in plate, and he looks quite formidable.  At the moment,
he is watching the children play with amusement.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An imperial cityguard guards the Grand Gate.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle guard cityguard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This peaceful creature looks at you with big dark eyes.  Her nose twitches as
she sniffs at you, but she goes back to chewing some grass.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A doe munches on grass.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle doe

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The deer looks angered at your intrusion.  He butts his head against you,
albeit ineffectively.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A deer stares back at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle deer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He eyes you with contained anger.  You'd better leave him alone!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A large deer stag protects his territory.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle stag deer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This bunny looks so adorable, you wished you had one just like this!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small bunny pokes from bush to bush.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bunny rabbit

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Upon careful inspection, you are sure it is NOT a cobra!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small snake slithers between the grass.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle snake

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He doesn't like you bothering him, but is too polite to ask you to leave.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A druid is here in meditation.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle druid

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: She wonders why you are staring at her, and how you got in here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A druidess peers at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle druidess

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This musical fellow plays a happy song with his fellow comrades.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A bard sings of the glory of Thalos.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle musician bard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This musical fellow wanders the world singing of the glory of Thalos.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: This bard merrily skips along singing of the glory of Thalos.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle musician bard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A cityguard stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle cityguard guard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A janitor is walking around, cleaning up.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle janitor

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Fido is a small dog that has a foul smell and pieces of rotted meat hanging
around his teeth.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Beastly Fido is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle fido dog

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A cityguard is here, guarding the gate.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle cityguard guard
